column2: After school, I had arranged to meet Shirona today.<LF>Peeking into the classroom, she was already there waiting alone.
Sorry, did you wait? Class ran long...<LF>Yours finished on time, I see.
Yeah. But I haven't been waiting that long, so it's fine.
...So, what's the reason you wanted to meet up with me?
Is it not okay to call you over<LF>unless I have a reason, %usernameusernameuserna%?
Shirona...<LF>No, it's not a problem at all.
I see, that's a relief.
Then shall we stop somewhere on the way?
Is there anywhere you want to go?
You can pick wherever you'd like to go, Shirona.
...Then, a macadamia nut specialty shop.
What kind of specialty shop is that...
Cookies, muffins, chocolate, tarts...<LF>It's packed with sweets made from macadamia nuts.
Super recommended.
Haha, then let's head there. Tell me your recommended picks too.
Of course. Leave it to me.
It's not that there's anything in particular I want to see, though.
...Then we can choose after we get there.<LF>That's sure to be fun too.
Yeah, true.
And so we headed for the movie theater in the City.
